title: Global Liquidity Rebounds: What Comes Next?
excerpt: After months of contraction, global liquidity conditions are showing convincing signs of recovery — driven by coordinated central bank balance sheet expansion and easing credit conditions in key markets.

title: Bitcoin Liquidity Dynamics: A New Regime?
excerpt: The approval of spot Bitcoin ETFs in the US has permanently altered the market structure of BTC liquidity — institutionalizing flows that were once episodic and retail-driven.

title: The DIXIE Index and Global Financial Conditions
excerpt: The US Dollar Index remains the most consequential single variable in global financial conditions — acting as both a thermometer and a thermostat for cross-border capital flows.

title: Why Yields Are Stuck (For Now)
excerpt: US 10-year Treasury yields have been trapped in a 4.2–4.7% range for months, confounding both bulls and bears. We examine the competing forces keeping rates rangebound.

title: ETF Flows Signal Risk-On Rotation
excerpt: Weekly ETF flow data reveals a significant shift in investor positioning — with money moving out of defensive sectors and short-duration bonds into equities, crypto, and commodity-linked products.

title: Oil Markets at a Crossroads
excerpt: Crude oil sits at a strategic inflection point, caught between OPEC+ supply discipline, slowing Chinese demand, and the prospect of a synchronized global recovery.

title: Fed Patience Tested
excerpt: The Federal Reserve's higher-for-longer posture is increasingly at odds with a softening labor market, rising credit stress, and the political calendar.
